author: dev_revs
body:
Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: Teamspeak

Staff Member: Zac

Guilty? (Yes or No): Depends on how you see it.

Why do you think you should be unbanned?: I never really have broken any rules on teamspeak before, or been involved in a scandal, so I am a first time offender. I poked Zac with "next time you don't leave my channel when asking ur fking ded" and He banned me for 30 days for death threats. I believe this ban was over exaggerated and I ask that I get pardoned this time, If a ban for this is really thirty days, then it needs to be revised because in-game its a kick/warn. I also have heard from reliable sources that I should of gotten a kick first.
Any additional comments?:
I ask you do not lock this thread please, and I would like to escalate this to a Senior. Thank you.

replies.body:
Hey dev_revs.

I do agree with you that 30 days is a while for a death threats ban. I will go ahead and change that to a 1 day ban and since it's been a day, you have been unbanned. 

Please don't do this again.

Regards,
